name: clawsec-clawhub-checker
title_zh: 装技能前先查 ClawHub 信誉分的门卫
tagline_zh: 装第三方技能像拆盲盒？它先查 ClawHub 信誉分，低于阈值直接拦下，不让你把未知代码请进家门。
tagline_en: Installing third-party skills shouldn't be a blind box. It checks ClawHub reputation first and blocks low-score.
desc_en: ClawHub reputation checker for clawsec-suite. Adds a standalone reputation gate before guarded skill installation.
why_zh: 把信誉检查从安装流程里单独拎出来，做成独立闸门。不信任链上任何一环，只认 ClawHub 的评分数据。
why_en: Isolates the reputation check as a standalone gate, trusting only ClawHub's score—not any link in the install chain.
limit_zh: 只查 ClawHub 上已收录技能的公开信誉分；私有仓库、未收录技能、或网络不通时它直接放行不拦截。
limit_en: Only checks public reputation scores for skills listed on ClawHub. Private repos, unlisted skills, or offline mode bypass it entirely.
title_en: Reputation gate before installing any ClawHub skill
